annotations.title: Measure the person's file inside the audit panel

description: Opens the audit panel in the chat. Without a spec, the panel receives the person's file, reads it in their browser and returns a profile of it: per column its kind, empty cells, distinct values, the values of categories with their counts, the range of numbers and dates, and the first rows. With a confirmed spec, the panel measures that same file in the browser with measure.py and shows one light per result. The file is not sent to this server.

columns.description: Optional: the column names of the file, to check the spec refers to real columns.

spec.description: The spec from start_audit, as confirmed by the person. Leave it out to open the panel first, to receive the file.
